ns2:course.label: Basic Photography
ns2:course.description: Investigates basic image making and meaning. Student works with digital camera, exposure meter and learns digital printing. Student must furnish camera. Class Materials Fee of $15 required. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term. Prerequisite: Freshman standing in Art and Design or in Art History major or minor; or consent of instructor.
